style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Artificial Frosted Foliage 6ft Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Bring the beauty of a winter woodland indoors with this 6ft artificial frosted foliage Christmas tree, designed to create a soft, magical festive atmosphere. Elegantly dusted with a realistic frosted finish, it captures the look of freshly snow-kissed branches, adding a touch of seasonal charm to your home. The delicate frosted detailing enhances the natural texture of the foliage, giving the tree depth, dimension and a beautifully wintry appearance. Its full, lifelike branches provide the perfect backdrop for your favourite decorations, from shimmering baubles to warm fairy lights, allowing you to style it to suit any festive theme. Standing at an impressive 6ft, this tree makes a stunning centrepiece for living rooms, hallways or dining spaces, instantly elevating your Christmas décor. Its snowy aesthetic pairs effortlessly with both traditional and modern styling, bringing a calm, elegant feel to your festive setup. Easy to assemble and designed for long-lasting use, this frosted Christmas tree offers all the visual impact of a wintery real tree without the mess or maintenance. A timeless seasonal favourite, it’s perfect for creating cosy, unforgettable Christmas moments year after year. Stand Dims: H15xD51cm.
